text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflation and a flattened diaphragm are classic signs of air trapping and lung volume increase seen in COPD, likely due to long-standing smoking or environmental exposure. Have you been smoking, or do you have a significant history of exposure to dust or chemical fumes?
